parameters.query:
SELECT id::text AS "clientId", code AS "clientCode"
FROM clients
WHERE ($1 <> '' AND id = NULLIF($1, '')::uuid)
   OR ($2 <> '' AND code = $2)
LIMIT 1

SELECT e.client_id::text AS "clientId", e.canonical_name, e.aliases, e.entity_type
FROM entities e
WHERE e.client_id = $1::uuid AND e.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY e.entity_type

-- P0.13: load the entity + client context that grounds the classification
-- prompt. No industry/business-model is hard-coded; the prompt is built from
-- the entity's real type and the client's verified claims / target markets.
SELECT e.canonical_name, e.entity_type,
       cl.primary_region, cl.primary_language,
       cl.target_markets::text AS target_markets,
       COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(clm.field_key || ': ' || clm.claim_text, ' | ')
                 FROM claims clm WHERE clm.entity_id = e.id
                   AND clm.verification IN ('VERIFIED','DRAFT')), '') AS verified_claims
FROM entities e
JOIN clients cl ON cl.id = e.client_id
WHERE e.client_id = $1::uuid AND e.canonical_name = $2 AND e.status = 'ACTIVE'
LIMIT 1
